# ascii.rest scenes

The 26 animated scenes and the `mount` function in this folder are from
[ascii.rest](https://ascii.rest) by Shubham ([@bas3line](https://github.com/bas3line)),
compiled unmodified from https://github.com/bas3line/ascii (npm 0.4.0, plus scenes
added after it transpiled from commit 9b00fce)
and used under the MIT License (see `LICENSE`).
